issues.description: Method SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery: the problem statement's UML explicitly marks acceptSupplyDelivery as public (notation '+acceptSupplyDelivery(...)') and the textual instructions treat it as part of the public API, but the solution implementation declares it with package-private visibility (no access modifier) as 'static void acceptSupplyDelivery(...)' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java. This mismatch between the expected public API (problem_statement.md) and the implemented package-private method can confuse students about the required visibility and may prevent callers outside the package from invoking the method as described.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery declaration to public static to match the UML and problem description: 'public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)'. Ensure example callers and tests can access the method as a public static API.
